name: Unpaid Ledger

Traits.name: Debtor's Trail
Traits.text: While tracking a creature that has dealt it damage since its last Long Rest, the unpaid ledger cannot be lost and ignores difficult terrain on the shortest road to that creature.
Traits.clause: The unpaid ledger always knows the shortest road to anything that owes it: it cannot be lost while tracking a creature t

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The unpaid ledger regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the unpaid ledger takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the unpaid ledger's next turn. The unpaid ledger dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The unpaid ledger makes three Seizing Hand attacks.

Actions.name: Seizing Hand
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
weldedRiders: If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

lore: A ledger-thing grown from uncollected dues, it walks the roads of folk who owe and takes its share from whatever is closest.
